extracted.intended_audience: dataset creators and dataset consumers in the machine learning / AI research community
extracted.subtask_description: Creating standardized datasheets that accompany datasets, documenting their purpose, contents, collection process, recommended uses, and other pertinent information to improve transparency and accountability in ML. Intended to guide dataset authors and inform dataset consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Datasheet accompaniment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Every dataset be accompanied with a datasheet that documents its motivation, composition, collection process, recommended uses, and so on.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By analogy to electronics industry component datasheets, the dataset datasheet should be provided alongside the dataset to communicate key details to consumers and facilitate informed use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document motivation
rubrics_metrics.description: The datasheet should document the dataset's motivation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain why the dataset was created, the problem(s) it is intended to address, and the goals or research questions motivating its collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document composition
rubrics_metrics.description: The datasheet should document the dataset's composition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe what the dataset contains (types of instances, labels, number of examples, distributions, subpopulations), including any relevant metadata that characterizes its contents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document collection process
rubrics_metrics.description: The datasheet should document the dataset's collection process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail how data were collected or generated, sampling procedures, time period, geographic scope, instrumentation or sources used, and any preprocessing or cleaning steps applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document recommended uses
rubrics_metrics.description: The datasheet should document recommended uses (and, by implication, limitations) of the dataset.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify intended uses, appropriate application domains, and cautionary notes about misuse or contexts where the dataset may be inappropriate; include any known limitations or potential sources of bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operating characteristics and test results
rubrics_metrics.description: The datasheet should describe operating characteristics, test results, and other information relevant to dataset behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analogous to electronic component datasheets, include evaluations, benchmarks, or diagnostics that illuminate dataset characteristics (e.g., label quality assessments, inter-annotator agreement, failure modes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote transparency and accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: Datasheets should facilitate better communication between dataset creators and dataset consumers and encourage the community to prioritize transparency and accountability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the datasheet to surface provenance, decision points, and documentation that enable others to understand, reproduce, and critically assess dataset construction and appropriate use.
